entries.claim: flex.one offers a Visa 'Global Card' connected directly to a user's stablecoin balance, spendable at 150M+ Visa merchants in 170+ countries.
The Flex Global Card balance is held in a non-custodial wallet; funding is via USDC/USDT from an external wallet, exchange, or ACH/wire.
Flex raised a $70 million Series B1 round led by Halo Fund to accelerate the launch of Flex Global.
Flex has raised a reported total of approximately $105 million in equity plus approximately $300 million in debt facilities.
Flex's named platform partners include Visa (network), Lead Bank (credit cards) and Thread Bank (banking services).
Flex Global (2025) spans stablecoin payment rails in 100+ countries, multi-currency accounts across 76 countries/32 currencies, institutional USD accounts, and private credit in 20+ countries.
Flex's reported revenue model comprises card/bill-pay interchange, deposit products, subscription, and credit.
The commercial model involves real-time liquidation of a stablecoin balance at point of sale via a BaaS-issued Visa card.

entries.claim: Flex's exact FX markup, interchange split and liquidation timing (who bears FX risk) are not publicly disclosed.

The entity targeted by the program anchor ('Flex.one' crypto-native consumer card issuing Mastercard/Visa) does not fully match the verifiable flex.one (US AI-native business banking platform issuing Visa).

entries.claim: Flex's mobile/web application internals (auth, framework, embedded SDKs) are unverified.
No Flex-specific on-chain contract or custody address has been verified against a public block explorer.
